construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within the isolated build directory

input.fixture_label: Required nonempty string beginning with synthetic, case-insensitive
input.products: 1..100 objects: unique id, name, attributes map keyed by canonical names or aliases
input.preferences: 1..30 unique attribute references with positive weight; numbers require lower/higher direction; categories require ordered distinct strings

shared_schema.validation: One normalize function and shared validators reject unknown fields, unknown attributes, ambiguous aliases, duplicate IDs/preferences, invalid shapes, nonfinite numbers, booleans as numbers and incompatible units. CLI additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8, invalid JSON and input exceeding 1 MB.
shared_schema.output: Success object: status=ok, fixture_label, canonical attributes/products/preferences, comparison rows containing product-id value maps, ranked products with score and per-preference contributions. Failure: status=error and message; exit 2.
shared_schema.numeric_limits: Raw values, converted values and weights finite within +/-1e12; weights strictly positive
shared_schema.normalization: Names trimmed, casefolded, whitespace replaced with underscores. Categories trimmed, casefolded and whitespace collapsed. Product IDs trimmed and case-sensitive. Bare numbers use the declared canonical unit; value/unit objects convert compatible units. Null and omitted attribute values remain null.

cross_stage_handoffs: Shared validation and normalization produce canonical product attribute maps.
Canonical maps feed both side-by-side comparison and deterministic preference ranking.
Comparison, normalized input and ranking are returned together as one JSON object.

behavior.units: Mass g/kg; decimal storage GB/TB (1000); length mm/cm/m; USD only; empty unit for dimensionless numbers. Units are case-sensitive; no currency conversion.
behavior.numeric_utility: Observed min-max utility in [0,1], inverted for lower-is-better. Equal observed values have utility 1. Missing values have utility 0, including when all values are missing.
behavior.category_utility: For n ordered values, position i (zero-based) has utility (n-i)/n. Unlisted or missing values have utility 0.
behavior.score: Sum of utilities weighted by weight divided by total preference weight. Missing data retains its weight and is not renormalized away.
behavior.ties: Sort descending by unrounded score, then ascending case-sensitive product ID; assign sequential ranks. Display scores/contributions rounded to six decimal places.
behavior.candidate_dependence: Min-max scores are relative to the supplied candidate set; this is not a global quality score.
behavior.fixtures: All example products, prices and specifications are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli: Example emitted one JSON object with status ok; exit 0; ranking a, c, b
test_outcomes.error_cli: Missing file and invalid argument counts emitted JSON status error and exit 2
